adaptation: Only WF_Fall (the falling sheet) depends on `drop`. WF_Upstream, the lip rocks, WF_Basin, WF_Foam, WF_Splash, WF_Mist and WF_Downstream are rigid parts placed from the anchors. The fall sheet UVs run in metres, so streak density and scroll speed (1.5 pattern-metres/sec) are identical at any drop.

anchorsLocal.note: y values are functions of drop D; z/x are fixed by the kit layout at width 2.0 and scale linearly with width/2 for x extents

demoInstance.where: module demo, legacy rocky highland (EnvironmentRenderer set piece)

frame: Local space of the kit group. Origin at the basin centre on the ground. Water flows from -Z (upstream) to +Z (downstream). Place the group at the basin point and rotate Y so +Z faces downstream.

inputs.drop: lip height above the basin in metres
inputs.particleTexture: soft round sprite for splash points
inputs.width: crest width in metres (the only horizontal parameter)

lifetime: The kit owns its geometries/materials/textures. Dispose via the owning renderer's dispose path; the foam textures are created per kit through AssetManager and are NOT shared with other kits.

placementConstraints.notes: Needs a terrain step: sample the ground at the upstream anchor and at the basin point; drop = upstreamY - basinY (+ledge lift if a rock knoll dressing is wanted). The upstream anchor must sit on or slightly above the upper water surface; the basin disc (radius = width * 0.85) must fit the lower flat. Do not scale the whole kit non-uniformly to fit a drop - pass the measured drop as the parameter.
